Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use a 1-hour Anthropic prompt-cache TTL, so effectively every allowed delay (the runtime clamps to [60, 3600]) wakes up with your conversation context still cached. There is no cache cliff inside that range to pace around, and scheduling extra wakeups just to keep the cache warm is pure waste — never do that. (If the session enters usage overage, later requests drop to the 5-minute TTL; don't try to track or preempt that — the guidance here stays the same.)

Match the delay to what you're actually waiting for:

- **Actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about** (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue): pick the delay from how fast that state actually changes. A CI run that takes ~8 minutes deserves one ~480s check, not eight 60s ones.
- **The long fallback heartbeat** (something else — a Monitor, a task notification — is the primary wake signal): 1200s+, so quiet wakeups stay rare.
- **Idle ticks with no specific signal to watch**: default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop still checks back regularly, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Don't think in cache windows — think about what you're actually waiting for.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

A workflow size guideline is configured for this session: small — keep workflows under 5 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale.

"""Contrato comum das trilhas: toda linha de saída carrega os componentes que a somam.

O writer recusa escrever uma linha cujo `valor` difere da soma dos componentes, então
o rastro.csv sai por construção e não tem como divergir dos números reportados.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
from typing import Any, Literal

ArquivoSaida = Literal[
    "comissoes_por_lojista.csv",
    "divergencias_taxa.csv",
    "notas_a_emitir.csv",
    "lancamentos_classificados.csv",
    "pendencias.csv",
]

CENTAVO = Decimal("0.01")


def brl(valor: Any) -> Decimal:
    """Converte para Decimal com 2 casas (ROUND_HALF_UP). Usar em todo valor em reais."""
    return Decimal(str(valor)).quantize(CENTAVO, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Componente:
    """Uma linha de origem que compõe um número de saída."""

    arquivo_origem: str  # nome do arquivo do data pack, ex. "01_orbe_relatorio_comissoes_set2026.csv"
    ref_origem: str  # id_transacao | Nº Operação | L10 | FITID
    valor: Decimal


@dataclass
class LinhaSaida:
    """Uma linha de um dos CSVs de saída.

    `campos` traz as colunas do arquivo, exceto `id_saida` (vem do atributo) e a coluna
    do número rastreado, que o writer preenche a partir de `valor`.
    `valor=None` indica linha sem número rastreado (não gera rastro).
    """

    arquivo: ArquivoSaida
    id_saida: str
    campos: dict[str, Any]
    valor: Decimal | None
    componentes: list[Componente] = field(default_factory=list)

    @classmethod
    def somando(
        cls, arquivo: ArquivoSaida, id_saida: str, campos: dict[str, Any], componentes: list[Componente]
    ) -> "LinhaSaida":
        """Cria a linha com `valor` = soma dos componentes (o caminho normal)."""
        total = sum((c.valor for c in componentes), Decimal(0))
        return cls(arquivo, id_saida, campos, total, componentes)


@dataclass
class ResultadoTrilha:
    """O que cada trilha devolve ao pipeline."""

    trilha: str
    linhas: list[LinhaSaida] = field(default_factory=list)
    # Invariantes de conservação: nome -> diferença. Tudo que entrou está numa saída
    # ou numa pendência; diferença diferente de zero é bug da trilha.
    conservacao: dict[str, Decimal] = field(default_factory=dict)


# Coluna que recebe o `valor` rastreado em cada arquivo.
COLUNA_VALOR: dict[str, str] = {
    "comissoes_por_lojista.csv": "comissao_brl",
    "divergencias_taxa.csv": "diferenca_brl",
    "notas_a_emitir.csv": "valor_brl",
    "lancamentos_classificados.csv": "valor",
    "pendencias.csv": "valor_brl",
}
"""Motor de execução da conciliação financeira Tarvo."""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from src.core.cadastro import montar_cadastro
from src.core.entrada import carregar
from src.core.writer import escrever
from src.premissas import PREMISSAS, Premissas
from src.trilhas import checkout, extratos, remessa


def run_pipeline(
    input_dir: Path, output_dir: Path, premissas: Premissas = PREMISSAS
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Carrega o data pack de `input_dir`, roda as 3 trilhas e grava os 6 CSVs em `output_dir`."""
    dados = carregar(Path(input_dir))
    cadastro = montar_cadastro(dados.taxas, premissas)

    resultados = [t.rodar(dados, cadastro, premissas) for t in (checkout, remessa, extratos)]
    linhas = [ln for r in resultados for ln in r.linhas]
    contagem = escrever(linhas, Path(output_dir))

    return {
        "arquivos": contagem,
        "conservacao": {r.trilha: r.conservacao for r in resultados},
    }
"""Escreve os 6 CSVs de saída no formato fixo do desafio.

Formato: separador `;`, ponto decimal, datas AAAA-MM-DD, CNPJ 14 dígitos (garantido
pelas trilhas). Antes de escrever, confere que todo `valor` é a soma exata dos seus
componentes — se não for, falha alto em vez de publicar número sem rastro.
"""

import csv
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from src.config import OUTPUT_FILES
from src.core.model import COLUNA_VALOR, LinhaSaida


class RastroNaoFecha(Exception):
    pass


def _fmt(v: Any) -> str:
    if v is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(v, (datetime, date)):
        return v.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    if isinstance(v, Decimal):
        return format(v, "f")
    return str(v)


def conferir_rastro(linhas: list[LinhaSaida]) -> None:
    erros = []
    ids_vistos: set[str] = set()
    for ln in linhas:
        if ln.id_saida in ids_vistos:
            erros.append(f"id_saida duplicado: {ln.id_saida}")
        ids_vistos.add(ln.id_saida)
        if ln.valor is None:
            continue
        soma = sum((c.valor for c in ln.componentes), Decimal(0))
        if not ln.componentes or soma != ln.valor:
            erros.append(f"{ln.id_saida}: valor={ln.valor} soma_componentes={soma}")
    if erros:
        raise RastroNaoFecha("\n".join(erros[:20]))


def escrever(linhas: list[LinhaSaida], output_dir: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    conferir_rastro(linhas)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    por_arquivo: dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]] = {nome: [] for nome in OUTPUT_FILES}

"""Contrato comum das trilhas: toda linha de saída carrega os componentes que a somam.

O writer recusa escrever uma linha cujo `valor` difere da soma dos componentes, então
o rastro.csv sai por construção e não tem como divergir dos números reportados.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
from typing import Any, Literal

ArquivoSaida = Literal[
    "comissoes_por_lojista.csv",
    "divergencias_taxa.csv",
    "notas_a_emitir.csv",
    "lancamentos_classificados.csv",
    "pendencias.csv",
]

CENTAVO = Decimal("0.01")


def brl(valor: Any) -> Decimal:
    """Converte para Decimal com 2 casas (ROUND_HALF_UP). Usar em todo valor em reais."""
    return Decimal(str(valor)).quantize(CENTAVO, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Componente:
    """Uma linha de origem que compõe um número de saída."""

    arquivo_origem: str  # nome do arquivo do data pack, ex. "01_orbe_relatorio_comissoes_set2026.csv"
    ref_origem: str  # id_transacao | Nº Operação | L10 | FITID
    valor: Decimal


@dataclass
class LinhaSaida:
    """Uma linha de um dos CSVs de saída.

    `campos` traz as colunas do arquivo, exceto `id_saida` (vem do atributo) e a coluna
    do número rastreado, que o writer preenche a partir de `valor`.
    `valor=None` indica linha sem número rastreado (não gera rastro).
    """

    arquivo: ArquivoSaida
    id_saida: str
    campos: dict[str, Any]
    valor: Decimal | None
    componentes: list[Componente] = field(default_factory=list)

    @classmethod
    def somando(
        cls, arquivo: ArquivoSaida, id_saida: str, campos: dict[str, Any], componentes: list[Componente]
    ) -> "LinhaSaida":
        """Cria a linha com `valor` = soma dos componentes (o caminho normal)."""
        total = sum((c.valor for c in componentes), Decimal(0))
        return cls(arquivo, id_saida, campos, total, componentes)


@dataclass
class ResultadoTrilha:
    """O que cada trilha devolve ao pipeline."""

    trilha: str
    linhas: list[LinhaSaida] = field(default_factory=list)
    # Invariantes de conservação: nome -> diferença. Tudo que entrou está numa saída
    # ou numa pendência; diferença diferente de zero é bug da trilha.
    conservacao: dict[str, Decimal] = field(default_factory=dict)


# Coluna que recebe o `valor` rastreado em cada arquivo.
COLUNA_VALOR: dict[str, str] = {
    "comissoes_por_lojista.csv": "comissao_brl",
    "divergencias_taxa.csv": "diferenca_brl",
    "notas_a_emitir.csv": "valor_brl",

}
"""Motor de execução da conciliação financeira Tarvo."""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from src.core.cadastro import montar_cadastro
from src.core.entrada import carregar
from src.core.writer import escrever
from src.premissas import PREMISSAS, Premissas
from src.trilhas import checkout, extratos, remessa


def run_pipeline(
    input_dir: Path, output_dir: Path, premissas: Premissas = PREMISSAS
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Carrega o data pack de `input_dir`, roda as 3 trilhas e grava os 6 CSVs em `output_dir`."""
    dados = carregar(Path(input_dir))
    cadastro = montar_cadastro(dados.taxas, premissas)

    resultados = [t.rodar(dados, cadastro, premissas) for t in (checkout, remessa, extratos)]
    linhas = [ln for r in resultados for ln in r.linhas]
    contagem = escrever(linhas, Path(output_dir))

class RastroNaoFecha(Exception):
    pass


def _fmt(v: Any) -> str:
    if v is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(v, (datetime, date)):
        return v.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    if isinstance(v, Decimal):
        return format(v, "f")
    return str(v)


def conferir_rastro(linhas: list[LinhaSaida]) -> None:
    erros = []
    ids_vistos: set[str] = set()
    for ln in linhas:
        if ln.id_saida in ids_vistos:
            erros.append(f"id_saida duplicado: {ln.id_saida}")
        ids_vistos.add(ln.id_saida)
        if ln.valor is None:
            continue
        soma = sum((c.valor for c in ln.componentes), Decimal(0))
        if not ln.componentes or soma != ln.valor:
            erros.append(f"{ln.id_saida}: valor={ln.valor} soma_componentes={soma}")
    if erros:
        raise RastroNaoFecha("\n".join(erros[:20]))

            row[COLUNA_VALOR[ln.arquivo]] = _fmt(ln.valor)

        for c in ln.componentes:

                {

                    "arquivo_origem": c.arquivo_origem,
                    "ref_origem": c.ref_origem,
                    "valor": _fmt(c.valor),

            )

    contagem = {}
    for nome, rows in por_arquivo.items():
        obrigatorias = OUTPUT_FILES[nome]
        extras = sorted({k for r in rows for k in r} - set(obrigatorias))
        with open(output_dir / nome, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=obrigatorias + extras, delimiter=";", restval="")
            w.writeheader()
            w.writerows(rows)
        contagem[nome] = len(rows)
    return contagem

input.description: Implement remessa trilha
input.prompt:
You are implementing one slice of a Python project under heavy time pressure (target: done in ~20 minutes; correct-and-partial beats complete-and-wrong). Work in Portuguese for any user-facing text (motivo, discriminacao); code comments short, Portuguese, citing rule IDs like the existing code does.

## Repo and hard constraints
- Repo: /home/<usuario>/Projetos/Sandbox/underdogs, branch `feat/alvo` (already checked out). Do NOT switch branches, commit, push, or open PRs. The lead will commit.
- ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN: reading or inspecting `tests/test_blackbox_immutable.py` or anything under `tests/fixtures/blackbox/`. Do not edit, loosen or delete any test file.
- You may edit ONLY `src/trilhas/remessa.py` and, if a real bug blocks you, `src/loaders/ponte.py`. Other people are editing `src/trilhas/checkout.py` and `src/trilhas/extratos.py` concurrently; do not touch them, nor `premissas.py`, `model.py`, `writer.py`, `entrada.py`, `cadastro.py`, `config.py`. If you need a parameter that is not in `premissas.py`, use a module-level constant in remessa.py with a comment citing the rule ID.
- Python: `.venv/bin/python` at the repo root (pandas, openpyxl, ofxparse, mypy available). Run everything from the repo root.
- Never invent information. Every rule must come from `HIPOTESES.md` (the source of truth: R-xx are answers from the client's finance person Helena, P-xx are team premises, §5 has independently computed control numbers). Where the materials don't determine something, emit a pendência instead of guessing. No fuzzy name matching: match lojistas by CNPJ only.

## Read first (quickly)
1. `HIPOTESES.md`: the remessa rules in §2 (R-11..R-20, R-24, R-27, R-28 and nearby), premises P-01, P-05, P-13, P-16, L-04, L-10, and the §5 control numbers for remessa.
2. `docs/lacunas-e-conflitos.md` §7 (what must become a pendência and what must NOT; items N-04/C-03/H-10, C-11, H-01, H-04, H-05, E-03).
3. `docs/tasks/dev2-remessa-extratos.md` (trilha B part). Its control numbers may be stale; HIPOTESES wins on any conflict.
4. Contract: `src/core/model.py` (Componente, LinhaSaida.somando, ResultadoTrilha, brl), `src/core/writer.py`, `src/config.py` OUTPUT_FILES (column names), and `src/trilhas/checkout.py` as the style example. Data comes in `dados.ponte` (see `src/loaders/ponte.py`), contracted spread via `cadastro` (see `src/core/cadastro.py`; rates there are in percentage points, e.g. 1.5 means 1,5%).

## What to build in `src/trilhas/remessa.py` — `rodar(dados, cadastro, premissas) -> ResultadoTrilha` (trilha="remessa")
Money is Decimal; round half-up to centavos per operation with `brl()` and only then sum. ## Final report (short)
What you implemented; counts per bank (lines read, classified, pendência-only); totals by account; balance reconciliation result; each pendência with value; every classification rule you used and its source (rule ID or plan-of-accounts description); anything you could not determine.

"""Trilha A — Checkout: comissão CHECKOUT por lojista, divergências de taxa, notas e pendências.

Regras: HIPOTESES.md §2.1 (comissão), §2.3 (divergências), §2.4 (notas), P-08 e P-13 (pendências).
"""

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

from src.core.cadastro import Cadastro
from src.core.entrada import DadosEntrada
from src.core.model import Componente, LinhaSaida, ResultadoTrilha, brl
from src.premissas import Premissas

TIPOS = ("VENDA", "ESTORNO", "ANTECIPACAO", "REVERSAO ANTECIPACAO")
HELENA = "Helena (Financeiro Tarvo)"


def _data(s: Any) -> date | None:
    s = str(s).strip() if s is not None else ""
    if not s or s == "nan":
        return None
    return datetime.strptime(s, "%d/%m/%Y").date()


def _brl_txt(v: Decimal) -> str:
    s = f"{v:,.2f}"
    return "R$ " + s.replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")


def _pct_txt(v: Decimal) -> str:
    return f"{v.normalize():f}".replace(".", ",") + "%"


def _pendencia(chave: str, tipo: str, comps: list[Componente], motivo: str, quem: str, regra: str) -> LinhaSaida:
    campos = {
        "tipo": tipo,
        "ref_origem": "|".join(c.ref_origem for c in comps),
        "motivo": motivo,
        "quem_decide": quem,
        "regra": regra,
    }
    return LinhaSaida.somando("pendencias.csv", f"PEN-CHK-{chave}", campos, comps)


def rodar(dados: DadosEntrada, cadastro: Cadastro, premissas: Premissas) -> ResultadoTrilha:
    res = ResultadoTrilha(trilha="checkout")
    nomes = {l.cnpj: l.nome for l in cadastro.lojistas()}
    registros = dados.orbe.to_dict("records")
    datas_mov = [d for d in (_data(r["data_movimento"]) for r in registros) if d]
    inicio_mes = min(datas_mov).replace(day=1) if datas_mov else None
    competencia = inicio_mes.strftime("%m/%Y") if inicio_mes else ""

    comp: dict[str, list[Componente]] = defaultdict(list)
    divs: dict[str, list[tuple[Componente, Decimal, Decimal]]] = defaultdict(list)
    isentos: dict[str, list[Componente]] = defaultdict(list)
    sem_contrato: dict[str, list[Componente]] = defaultdict(list)
    sem_contrato_info: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
    fora_regra: list[tuple[Componente, str]] = []

    for r in registros:
        ec = str(r["cod_estabelecimento"]).strip()
        tipo = str(r["tipo_lancamento"]).strip()
        ref = str(r["id_transacao"])
        arq = r["arquivo_origem"]
        valor_taxa = r["valor_taxa"] if r["valor_taxa"] is not None else Decimal(0)
        if tipo not in TIPOS:
            # R-42: avisa sem quebrar. Fica fora da comissão até alguém dizer o que é.
            fora_regra.append((Componente(arq, ref, valor_taxa), f"tipo_lancamento desconhecido {tipo!r}"))
            continue
        loj = cadastro.lojista_por_ec(ec)  # R-05: aliases só via cadastro
        if tipo == "VENDA":
            modalidade, data_ref = r["modalidade"], _data(r["data_movimento"])
        elif tipo == "ESTORNO":
            # R-03: taxa da data da venda original; faixa vem da linha do estorno.
            modalidade, data_ref = r["modalidade"], _data(r["data_venda_original"])
        elif tipo == "ANTECIPACAO":
            # R-44: vale a data da antecipação.

def _alertas_antecipacao(registros: list[dict[str, Any]], cadastro: Cadastro, inicio_mes: date) -> list[LinhaSaida]:
    """P-08: lojista sem venda antes do mês cuja antecipação acumulada supera as vendas acumuladas (o pico).

    "Sem venda antes do mês", pelo que os arquivos mostram: nenhuma linha da Orbe aponta para venda
    anterior ao mês e o EC não tem taxa vigente na planilha no primeiro dia do mês.
    """
    por_ec: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    antigo: set[str] = set()
    for r in registros:
        ec = str(r["cod_estabelecimento"]).strip()
        por_ec[ec].append(r)
        dvo = _data(r["data_venda_original"])
        if dvo and dvo < inicio_mes:
            antigo.add(ec)

    saida = []
    for ec in sorted(por_ec):
        if ec in antigo:
            continue
        loj = cadastro.lojista_por_ec(ec)
        if loj and cadastro.taxa_contratada_pct(loj.cnpj, "DEBITO", 1, inicio_mes) is not None:
            continue
        linhas = sorted(
            (r for r in por_ec[ec] if r["tipo_lancamento"] in TIPOS and r["tipo_lancamento"] != "ESTORNO"),
            key=lambda r: _data(r["data_movimento"]) or inicio_mes,
        )
        ant = ven = Decimal(0)
        pico: tuple[Decimal, date | None, Decimal, Decimal] = (Decimal(0), None, Decimal(0), Decimal(0))
        dias = sorted({_data(r["data_movimento"]) for r in linhas} - {None})
        for dia in dias:
            for r in linhas:
                if _data(r["data_movimento"]) != dia:
                    continue
                if r["tipo_lancamento"] == "VENDA":
                    ven += r["valor_bruto"]
                else:
                    ant += r["valor_bruto"]
            if ant - ven > pico[0]:
                pico = (ant - ven, dia, ant, ven)
        excesso, dia_pico, ant_pico, ven_pico = pico
        if dia_pico is None:

        comps = [
            Componente(
                r["arquivo_origem"],
                str(r["id_transacao"]),
                r["valor_bruto"] if r["tipo_lancamento"] != "VENDA" else -r["valor_bruto"],
            )
            for r in linhas
            if (_data(r["data_movimento"]) or inicio_mes) <= dia_pico
        ]
        reversoes = [r for r in linhas if r["tipo_lancamento"] == "REVERSAO ANTECIPACAO"]
        rev_txt = (
            f" Houve {len(reversoes)} reversões de antecipação no mês, somando "
            f"{_brl_txt(-sum((r['valor_bruto'] for r in reversoes), Decimal(0)))}."
            if reversoes
            else ""
        )
        nome = loj.nome if loj else str(linhas[0]["nome_estabelecimento"]).strip() if linhas else ec
        saida.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"ANTECIPACAO-{ec}",
                "ALERTA_ANTECIPACAO",
                comps,
                f"{nome} (EC {ec}), lojista sem venda antes do mês: em {dia_pico:%d/%m} a antecipação acumulada "
                f"({_brl_txt(ant_pico)}) superou as vendas acumuladas ({_brl_txt(ven_pico)}) em {_brl_txt(excesso)}."
                f"{rev_txt} Valor = antecipações menos vendas até o pico.",
                f"{HELENA} e Comercial",
                "P-08 R-36",
            )
        )
    return saida

"""Trilha A — Checkout: comissão CHECKOUT por lojista, divergências de taxa, notas e pendências.

Regras: HIPOTESES.md §2.1 (comissão), §2.3 (divergências), §2.4 (notas), P-08 e P-13 (pendências).
"""

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

from src.core.cadastro import Cadastro
from src.core.entrada import DadosEntrada
from src.core.model import Componente, LinhaSaida, ResultadoTrilha, brl
from src.premissas import Premissas

TIPOS = ("VENDA", "ESTORNO", "ANTECIPACAO", "REVERSAO ANTECIPACAO")
HELENA = "Helena (Financeiro Tarvo)"


def _data(s: Any) -> date | None:
    s = str(s).strip() if s is not None else ""
    if not s or s == "nan":
        return None
    return datetime.strptime(s, "%d/%m/%Y").date()


def _brl_txt(v: Decimal) -> str:
    s = f"{v:,.2f}"
    return "R$ " + s.replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")


def _pct_txt(v: Decimal) -> str:
    return f"{v.normalize():f}".replace(".", ",") + "%"


def _pendencia(chave: str, tipo: str, comps: list[Componente], motivo: str, quem: str, regra: str) -> LinhaSaida:
    campos = {
        "tipo": tipo,
        "ref_origem": "|".join(c.ref_origem for c in comps),
        "motivo": motivo,
        "quem_decide": quem,
        "regra": regra,
    }
    return LinhaSaida.somando("pendencias.csv", f"PEN-CHK-{chave}", campos, comps)


def rodar(dados: DadosEntrada, cadastro: Cadastro, premissas: Premissas) -> ResultadoTrilha:
    res = ResultadoTrilha(trilha="checkout")
    nomes = {l.cnpj: l.nome for l in cadastro.lojistas()}
    registros = dados.orbe.to_dict("records")
    datas_mov = [d for d in (_data(r["data_movimento"]) for r in registros) if d]
    inicio_mes = min(datas_mov).replace(day=1) if datas_mov else None
    competencia = inicio_mes.strftime("%m/%Y") if inicio_mes else ""

    comp: dict[str, list[Componente]] = defaultdict(list)
    divs: dict[str, list[tuple[Componente, Decimal, Decimal]]] = defaultdict(list)
    isentos: dict[str, list[Componente]] = defaultdict(list)
    sem_contrato: dict[str, list[Componente]] = defaultdict(list)
    sem_contrato_info: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
    fora_regra: list[tuple[Componente, str]] = []

    for r in registros:
        ec = str(r["cod_estabelecimento"]).strip()
        tipo = str(r["tipo_lancamento"]).strip()
        ref = str(r["id_transacao"])
        arq = r["arquivo_origem"]
        valor_taxa = r["valor_taxa"] if r["valor_taxa"] is not None else Decimal(0)
        if tipo not in TIPOS:
            # R-42: avisa sem quebrar. Fica fora da comissão até alguém dizer o que é.
            fora_regra.append((Componente(arq, ref, valor_taxa), f"tipo_lancamento desconhecido {tipo!r}"))
            continue
        loj = cadastro.lojista_por_ec(ec)  # R-05: aliases só via cadastro
        if tipo == "VENDA":
            modalidade, data_ref = r["modalidade"], _data(r["data_movimento"])
        elif tipo == "ESTORNO":
            # R-03: taxa da data da venda original; faixa vem da linha do estorno.
            modalidade, data_ref = r["modalidade"], _data(r["data_venda_original"])
        elif tipo == "ANTECIPACAO":
            # R-44: vale a data da antecipação.
            modalidade, data_ref = "ANTECIPACAO", _data(r["data_movimento"])
        else:
            modalidade, data_ref = "ANTECIPACAO", _data(r["data_venda_original"])

        parcelas = int(r["qtd_parcelas"]) if str(r["qtd_parcelas"]).strip() not in ("", "nan") else 1
        if tipo in ("VENDA", "ESTORNO") and str(modalidade).strip() == "CREDITO PARCELADO" and parcelas > 12:
            fora_regra.append((Componente(arq, ref, valor_taxa), f"crédito parcelado em {parcelas}x (R-10)"))
            continue
        taxa = (
            cadastro.taxa_contratada_pct(loj.cnpj, str(modalidade), parcelas, data_ref)
            if loj and data_ref
            else None
        )
        if loj is None or taxa is None:
            # R-06: sem taxa vigente não fatura; o que a Orbe cobrou fica na pendência.
            sem_contrato[ec].append(Componente(arq, ref, valor_taxa))
            sem_contrato_info.setdefault(ec, (str(r["nome_estabelecimento"]).strip(), "" if loj is None else loj.cnpj))
            continue

        isento = any(i.cnpj == loj.cnpj and i.inicio <= data_ref <= i.fim for i in premissas.isencoes_checkout)  # R-08
        # R-01: taxa contratada sobre valor_bruto (já negativo em estorno/reversão); R-02: half-up por linha.
        valor = brl(0) if isento else brl(r["valor_bruto"] * taxa / 100)
        comp[loj.cnpj].append(Componente(arq, ref, valor))
        if isento:
            # R-09: o que a Orbe cobrou na isenção é devolução ao lojista, não divergência.
            isentos[loj.cnpj].append(Componente(arq, ref, valor_taxa))
            continue
        aplicada = r["taxa_aplicada_pct"]
        if aplicada is not None and aplicada != taxa:
            # R-20, R-21: transação a transação, estorno com sinal negativo.
            dif = brl(r["valor_bruto"] * (aplicada - taxa) / 100)
            divs[loj.cnpj].append((Componente(arq, ref, dif), taxa, aplicada))

    # comissoes_por_lojista.csv e notas_a_emitir.csv (R-26, R-28)
    for cnpj in sorted(comp):
        campos = {"cnpj": cnpj, "lojista": nomes[cnpj], "linha_negocio": "CHECKOUT", "regra": "R-01 R-02 R-03 R-04 R-08 R-44"}
        linha = LinhaSaida.somando("comissoes_por_lojista.csv", f"COM-CHK-{cnpj}", campos, comp[cnpj])
        res.linhas.append(linha)
        assert linha.valor is not None
        if linha.valor > 0:
            nota = {
                "tomador_cnpj": cnpj,
                "tomador": nomes[cnpj],
                "linha_negocio": "CHECKOUT",
                "discriminacao": f"Comissão de intermediação de pagamentos (checkout), competência {competencia}",
                "regra": "R-26 R-28 R-45",
            }
            res.linhas.append(LinhaSaida.somando("notas_a_emitir.csv", f"NF-CHK-{cnpj}", nota, comp[cnpj]))
        else:
            res.linhas.append(
                _pendencia(
                    f"NOTA-{cnpj}",
                    "NOTA_NAO_EMITIDA",
                    [c for c in comp[cnpj] if c.valor != 0],
                    f"{nomes[cnpj]}: comissão de checkout de {competencia} é {_brl_txt(linha.valor)}. "
                    "Comissão zero ou negativa não emite nota e não passa automaticamente para o mês seguinte.",
                    HELENA,
                    "R-26",
                )
            )

    # divergencias_taxa.csv, transação a transação, e uma pendência por lojista (P-13, R-37)
    for cnpj in sorted(divs):
        for c, contratada, aplicada in divs[cnpj]:
            campos = {
                "cnpj": cnpj,
                "linha_negocio": "CHECKOUT",
                "ref_origem": c.ref_origem,
                "taxa_contratada_pct": contratada.normalize(),
                "taxa_aplicada_pct": aplicada.normalize(),
                "regra": "R-20 R-21 R-22",
            }
            res.linhas.append(LinhaSaida.somando("divergencias_taxa.csv", f"DIV-CHK-{c.ref_origem}", campos, [c]))
        pares = sorted({(ct, ap) for _, ct, ap in divs[cnpj]})
        taxas_txt = "; ".join(f"contratada {_pct_txt(ct)}, Orbe aplicou {_pct_txt(ap)}" for ct, ap in pares)
        comps = [c for c, _, _ in divs[cnpj]]
        total = sum((c.valor for c in comps), Decimal(0))
        res.linhas.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"DIV-{cnpj}",
                "DIVERGENCIA_TAXA_ORBE",
                comps,
                f"{nomes[cnpj]}: a Orbe cobrou taxa diferente do contrato em {len(comps)} transações ({taxas_txt}). "
                f"Diferença líquida {_brl_txt(total)}: o lojista recebeu a menos e deve ser ressarcido; "
                "contestar com a Orbe. Vale o contrato, não o aviso.",
                f"{HELENA}: contestar com a Orbe",
                "R-20 R-21 R-22 R-25 R-37",
            )
        )

    # R-09: devolução da isenção (Casa do Estudante)
    for cnpj in sorted(isentos):
        comps = isentos[cnpj]
        total = sum((c.valor for c in comps), Decimal(0))
        res.linhas.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"ISENCAO-{cnpj}",
                "DEVOLUCAO_ISENCAO",
                comps,
                f"{nomes[cnpj]}: tarifa zero no checkout por concessão do comercial, mas a Orbe cobrou "
                f"{_brl_txt(total)} em {len(comps)} transações isentas. É devolução ao lojista, paga pela Tarvo, "
                "e não divergência de contrato. A Orbe não foi avisada da isenção: o desconto se repete no mês seguinte.",
                f"{HELENA} e Comercial",
                "R-08 R-09 R-44 R-49",
            )
        )

    # R-06, R-07: EC sem taxa vigente
    for ec in sorted(sem_contrato):
        comps = sem_contrato[ec]
        nome_orbe, cnpj = sem_contrato_info[ec]
        total = sum((c.valor for c in comps), Decimal(0))
        quem_e = f"EC {ec} ({nome_orbe})" + (f", CNPJ {cnpj}" if cnpj else ", sem lojista na aba de taxas vigente")
        res.linhas.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"SEMCONTRATO-{ec}",
                "SEM_CONTRATO",
                comps,
                f"{quem_e}: {len(comps)} transações sem taxa contratada vigente, fora da comissão e da nota. "
                f"A Orbe cobrou {_brl_txt(total)}. Não faturar até o comercial confirmar a taxa; quando confirmar, "
                "a taxa vale desde o início e estas linhas entram no fechamento seguinte.",
                "Comercial",
                "R-06 R-07",
            )
        )

    for i, (c, motivo) in enumerate(fora_regra, 1):
        res.linhas.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"FORAREGRA-{c.ref_origem}",
                "LANCAMENTO_FORA_DA_REGRA",
                [c],
                f"Transação {c.ref_origem}: {motivo}. Ficou fora da comissão; valor = taxa cobrada pela Orbe.",
                HELENA,
                "R-10 R-42",
            )
        )

    # P-08: alerta de antecipação para lojista sem venda antes do mês
    if inicio_mes:
        for linha in _alertas_antecipacao(registros, cadastro, inicio_mes):
            res.linhas.append(linha)

    n_saida = sum(len(v) for v in comp.values()) + sum(len(v) for v in sem_contrato.values()) + len(fora_regra)
    res.conservacao["linhas_orbe"] = Decimal(len(registros) - n_saida)
    for ec, cs in sorted(sem_contrato.items()):
        res.conservacao[f"sem_contrato_{ec}"] = Decimal(len(cs))
    return res


def _alertas_antecipacao(registros: list[dict[str, Any]], cadastro: Cadastro, inicio_mes: date) -> list[LinhaSaida]:
    """P-08: lojista sem venda antes do mês cuja antecipação acumulada supera as vendas acumuladas (o pico).

    "Sem venda antes do mês", pelo que os arquivos mostram: nenhuma linha da Orbe aponta para venda
    anterior ao mês e o EC não tem taxa vigente na planilha no primeiro dia do mês.
    """
    por_ec: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    antigo: set[str] = set()
    for r in registros:
        ec = str(r["cod_estabelecimento"]).strip()
        por_ec[ec].append(r)
        dvo = _data(r["data_venda_original"])
        if dvo and dvo < inicio_mes:
            antigo.add(ec)

    saida = []
    for ec in sorted(por_ec):
        if ec in antigo:
            continue
        loj = cadastro.lojista_por_ec(ec)
        if loj and cadastro.taxa_contratada_pct(loj.cnpj, "DEBITO", 1, inicio_mes) is not None:
            continue
        linhas = sorted(
            (r for r in por_ec[ec] if r["tipo_lancamento"] in TIPOS and r["tipo_lancamento"] != "ESTORNO"),
            key=lambda r: _data(r["data_movimento"]) or inicio_mes,
        )
        ant = ven = Decimal(0)
        pico: tuple[Decimal, date | None, Decimal, Decimal] = (Decimal(0), None, Decimal(0), Decimal(0))
        dias = sorted({_data(r["data_movimento"]) for r in linhas} - {None})
        for dia in dias:
            for r in linhas:
                if _data(r["data_movimento"]) != dia:
                    continue
                if r["tipo_lancamento"] == "VENDA":
                    ven += r["valor_bruto"]
                else:
                    ant += r["valor_bruto"]
            if ant - ven > pico[0]:
                pico = (ant - ven, dia, ant, ven)
        excesso, dia_pico, ant_pico, ven_pico = pico
        if dia_pico is None:
            continue
        comps = [
            Componente(
                r["arquivo_origem"],
                str(r["id_transacao"]),
                r["valor_bruto"] if r["tipo_lancamento"] != "VENDA" else -r["valor_bruto"],
            )
            for r in linhas
            if (_data(r["data_movimento"]) or inicio_mes) <= dia_pico
        ]
        reversoes = [r for r in linhas if r["tipo_lancamento"] == "REVERSAO ANTECIPACAO"]
        rev_txt = (
            f" Houve {len(reversoes)} reversões de antecipação no mês, somando "
            f"{_brl_txt(-sum((r['valor_bruto'] for r in reversoes), Decimal(0)))}."
            if reversoes
            else ""
        )
        nome = loj.nome if loj else str(linhas[0]["nome_estabelecimento"]).strip() if linhas else ec
        saida.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"ANTECIPACAO-{ec}",
                "ALERTA_ANTECIPACAO",
                comps,
                f"{nome} (EC {ec}), lojista sem venda antes do mês: em {dia_pico:%d/%m} a antecipação acumulada "
                f"({_brl_txt(ant_pico)}) superou as vendas acumuladas ({_brl_txt(ven_pico)}) em {_brl_txt(excesso)}."
                f"{rev_txt} Valor = antecipações menos vendas até o pico.",
                f"{HELENA} e Comercial",
                "P-08 R-36",
            )
        )
    return saida

"""Trilha A — Checkout (Dev 1): comissão CHECKOUT por lojista (nível mínimo).

Divergências de taxa, notas e pendências ficam para as próximas fatias.
"""

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from src.core.cadastro import Cadastro
from src.core.entrada import DadosEntrada
from src.core.model import Componente, LinhaSaida, ResultadoTrilha, brl
from src.premissas import Premissas


def _data(s: str) -> date:
    return datetime.strptime(s.strip(), "%d/%m/%Y").date()


def rodar(dados: DadosEntrada, cadastro: Cadastro, premissas: Premissas) -> ResultadoTrilha:
    comp: dict[str, list[Componente]] = defaultdict(list)
    sem_contrato: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    n_comissao = 0
    n_sem = 0

    for r in dados.orbe.to_dict("records"):
        ec = str(r["cod_estabelecimento"]).strip()
        tipo = str(r["tipo_lancamento"]).strip()
        loj = cadastro.lojista_por_ec(ec)  # R-05: aliases só via cadastro
        if tipo == "VENDA":
            modalidade, data_ref = r["modalidade"], _data(r["data_movimento"])
        elif tipo == "ESTORNO":
            # R-03: taxa da data da venda original; faixa vem da linha do estorno.
            modalidade, data_ref = r["modalidade"], _data(r["data_venda_original"])
        elif tipo == "ANTECIPACAO":
            # R-44: vale a data da antecipação.
            modalidade, data_ref = "ANTECIPACAO", _data(r["data_movimento"])
        elif tipo == "REVERSAO ANTECIPACAO":
            modalidade, data_ref = "ANTECIPACAO", _data(r["data_venda_original"])
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Orbe: tipo_lancamento desconhecido {tipo!r} em {r['id_transacao']}")

        parcelas = int(r["qtd_parcelas"]) if str(r["qtd_parcelas"]).strip() not in ("", "nan") else 1
        taxa = (
            cadastro.taxa_contratada_pct(loj.cnpj, str(modalidade), parcelas, data_ref) if loj else None
        )
        if loj is None or taxa is None:
            sem_contrato[ec] += 1
            n_sem += 1
            continue

        isento = any(i.cnpj == loj.cnpj and i.inicio <= data_ref <= i.fim for i in premissas.isencoes_checkout)  # R-08
        # R-01: taxa contratada sobre valor_bruto (já negativo em estorno/reversão); R-02: half-up por linha.
        valor = brl(0) if isento else brl(r["valor_bruto"] * taxa / 100)
        comp[loj.cnpj].append(Componente(r["arquivo_origem"], r["id_transacao"], valor))
        n_comissao += 1

    res = ResultadoTrilha(trilha="checkout")
    nomes = {l.cnpj: l.nome for l in cadastro.lojistas()}
    for cnpj in sorted(comp):
        campos = {"cnpj": cnpj, "lojista": nomes[cnpj], "linha_negocio": "CHECKOUT"}
        res.linhas.append(LinhaSaida.somando("comissoes_por_lojista.csv", f"COM-CHK-{cnpj}", campos, comp[cnpj]))

    res.conservacao["linhas_orbe"] = Decimal(len(dados.orbe) - (n_comissao + n_sem))
    for ec, n in sorted(sem_contrato.items()):
        res.conservacao[f"sem_contrato_{ec}"] = Decimal(n)
    return res

"""Trilha A — Checkout: comissão CHECKOUT por lojista, divergências de taxa, notas e pendências.

Regras: HIPOTESES.md §2.1 (comissão), §2.3 (divergências), §2.4 (notas), P-08 e P-13 (pendências).
"""

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

from src.core.cadastro import Cadastro
from src.core.entrada import DadosEntrada
from src.core.model import Componente, LinhaSaida, ResultadoTrilha, brl
from src.premissas import Premissas

TIPOS = ("VENDA", "ESTORNO", "ANTECIPACAO", "REVERSAO ANTECIPACAO")
HELENA = "Helena (Financeiro Tarvo)"


def _data(s: Any) -> date | None:
    s = str(s).strip() if s is not None else ""
    if not s or s == "nan":
        return None
    return datetime.strptime(s, "%d/%m/%Y").date()


def _brl_txt(v: Decimal) -> str:
    s = f"{v:,.2f}"
    return "R$ " + s.replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")


def _pct_txt(v: Decimal) -> str:
    return f"{v.normalize():f}".replace(".", ",") + "%"


def _pendencia(chave: str, tipo: str, comps: list[Componente], motivo: str, quem: str, regra: str) -> LinhaSaida:
    campos = {
        "tipo": tipo,
        "ref_origem": "|".join(c.ref_origem for c in comps),
        "motivo": motivo,
        "quem_decide": quem,
        "regra": regra,
    }
    return LinhaSaida.somando("pendencias.csv", f"PEN-CHK-{chave}", campos, comps)


def rodar(dados: DadosEntrada, cadastro: Cadastro, premissas: Premissas) -> ResultadoTrilha:
    res = ResultadoTrilha(trilha="checkout")
    nomes = {l.cnpj: l.nome for l in cadastro.lojistas()}
    registros = dados.orbe.to_dict("records")
    datas_mov = [d for d in (_data(r["data_movimento"]) for r in registros) if d]
    inicio_mes = min(datas_mov).replace(day=1) if datas_mov else None
    competencia = inicio_mes.strftime("%m/%Y") if inicio_mes else ""

    comp: dict[str, list[Componente]] = defaultdict(list)
    divs: dict[str, list[tuple[Componente, Decimal, Decimal]]] = defaultdict(list)
    isentos: dict[str, list[Componente]] = defaultdict(list)
    sem_contrato: dict[str, list[Componente]] = defaultdict(list)
    sem_contrato_info: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
    fora_regra: list[tuple[Componente, str]] = []

    for r in registros:
        ec = str(r["cod_estabelecimento"]).strip()
        tipo = str(r["tipo_lancamento"]).strip()
        ref = str(r["id_transacao"])
        arq = r["arquivo_origem"]
        valor_taxa = r["valor_taxa"] if r["valor_taxa"] is not None else Decimal(0)
        if tipo not in TIPOS:
            # R-42: avisa sem quebrar. Fica fora da comissão até alguém dizer o que é.
            fora_regra.append((Componente(arq, ref, valor_taxa), f"tipo_lancamento desconhecido {tipo!r}"))
            continue
        loj = cadastro.lojista_por_ec(ec)  # R-05: aliases só via cadastro
        if tipo == "VENDA":
            modalidade, data_ref = r["modalidade"], _data(r["data_movimento"])
        elif tipo == "ESTORNO":
            # R-03: taxa da data da venda original; faixa vem da linha do estorno.
            modalidade, data_ref = r["modalidade"], _data(r["data_venda_original"])
        elif tipo == "ANTECIPACAO":
            # R-44: vale a data da antecipação.
            modalidade, data_ref = "ANTECIPACAO", _data(r["data_movimento"])
        else:
            modalidade, data_ref = "ANTECIPACAO", _data(r["data_venda_original"])

        parcelas = int(r["qtd_parcelas"]) if str(r["qtd_parcelas"]).strip() not in ("", "nan") else 1
        if tipo in ("VENDA", "ESTORNO") and str(modalidade).strip() == "CREDITO PARCELADO" and parcelas > 12:
            fora_regra.append((Componente(arq, ref, valor_taxa), f"crédito parcelado em {parcelas}x (R-10)"))
            continue
        taxa = (
            cadastro.taxa_contratada_pct(loj.cnpj, str(modalidade), parcelas, data_ref)
            if loj and data_ref
            else None
        )
        if loj is None or taxa is None:
            # R-06: sem taxa vigente não fatura; o que a Orbe cobrou fica na pendência.
            sem_contrato[ec].append(Componente(arq, ref, valor_taxa))
            sem_contrato_info.setdefault(ec, (str(r["nome_estabelecimento"]).strip(), "" if loj is None else loj.cnpj))

        isento = any(i.cnpj == loj.cnpj and i.inicio <= data_ref <= i.fim for i in premissas.isencoes_checkout)  # R-08
        # R-01: taxa contratada sobre valor_bruto (já negativo em estorno/reversão); R-02: half-up por linha.
        valor = brl(0) if isento else brl(r["valor_bruto"] * taxa / 100)
        comp[loj.cnpj].append(Componente(arq, ref, valor))

                    "R-26",
                )
            )

    for cnpj in sorted(divs):

            campos = {
                "cnpj": cnpj,
                "linha_negocio": "CHECKOUT",
                "ref_origem": c.ref_origem,
                "taxa_contratada_pct": contratada.normalize(),
                "taxa_aplicada_pct": aplicada.normalize(),
                "regra": "R-20 R-21 R-22",
            }
            res.linhas.append(LinhaSaida.somando("divergencias_taxa.csv", f"DIV-CHK-{c.ref_origem}", campos, [c]))
        pares = sorted({(ct, ap) for _, ct, ap in divs[cnpj]})
        taxas_txt = "; ".join(f"contratada {_pct_txt(ct)}, Orbe aplicou {_pct_txt(ap)}" for ct, ap in pares)
        comps = [c for c, _, _ in divs[cnpj]]
        total = sum((c.valor for c in comps), Decimal(0))
        res.linhas.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"DIV-{cnpj}",
                "DIVERGENCIA_TAXA_ORBE",
                comps,
                f"{nomes[cnpj]}: a Orbe cobrou taxa diferente do contrato em {len(comps)} transações ({taxas_txt}). "
                f"Diferença líquida {_brl_txt(total)}: o lojista recebeu a menos e deve ser ressarcido; "
                "contestar com a Orbe. Vale o contrato, não o aviso.",
                f"{HELENA}: contestar com a Orbe",
                "R-20 R-21 R-22 R-25 R-37",
            )
        )

    # R-09: devolução da isenção (Casa do Estudante)
    for cnpj in sorted(isentos):
        comps = isentos[cnpj]
        total = sum((c.valor for c in comps), Decimal(0))
        res.linhas.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"ISENCAO-{cnpj}",
                "DEVOLUCAO_ISENCAO",
                comps,
                f"{nomes[cnpj]}: tarifa zero no checkout por concessão do comercial, mas a Orbe cobrou "
                f"{_brl_txt(total)} em {len(comps)} transações isentas. É devolução ao lojista, paga pela Tarvo, "
                "e não divergência de contrato. A Orbe não foi avisada da isenção: o desconto se repete no mês seguinte.",
                f"{HELENA} e Comercial",
                "R-08 R-09 R-44 R-49",
            )
        )

    # R-06, R-07: EC sem taxa vigente
    for ec in sorted(sem_contrato):
        comps = sem_contrato[ec]
        nome_orbe, cnpj = sem_contrato_info[ec]
        total = sum((c.valor for c in comps), Decimal(0))
        quem_e = f"EC {ec} ({nome_orbe})" + (f", CNPJ {cnpj}" if cnpj else ", sem lojista na aba de taxas vigente")
        res.linhas.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"SEMCONTRATO-{ec}",
                "SEM_CONTRATO",
                comps,
                f"{quem_e}: {len(comps)} transações sem taxa contratada vigente, fora da comissão e da nota. "
                f"A Orbe cobrou {_brl_txt(total)}. Não faturar até o comercial confirmar a taxa; quando confirmar, "
                "a taxa vale desde o início e estas linhas entram no fechamento seguinte.",
                "Comercial",
                "R-06 R-07",
            )
        )

    for i, (c, motivo) in enumerate(fora_regra, 1):
        res.linhas.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"FORAREGRA-{c.ref_origem}",
                "LANCAMENTO_FORA_DA_REGRA",
                [c],
                f"Transação {c.ref_origem}: {motivo}. Ficou fora da comissão; valor = taxa cobrada pela Orbe.",
                HELENA,
                "R-10 R-42",
            )
        )

    # P-08: alerta de antecipação para lojista sem venda antes do mês
    if inicio_mes:
        for linha in _alertas_antecipacao(registros, cadastro, inicio_mes):
            res.linhas.append(linha)

    n_saida = sum(len(v) for v in comp.values()) + sum(len(v) for v in sem_contrato.values()) + len(fora_regra)
    res.conservacao["linhas_orbe"] = Decimal(len(registros) - n_saida)
    for ec, cs in sorted(sem_contrato.items()):
        res.conservacao[f"sem_contrato_{ec}"] = Decimal(len(cs))
    return res


def _alertas_antecipacao(registros: list[dict[str, Any]], cadastro: Cadastro, inicio_mes: date) -> list[LinhaSaida]:
    """P-08: lojista sem venda antes do mês cuja antecipação acumulada supera as vendas acumuladas (o pico).

    "Sem venda antes do mês", pelo que os arquivos mostram: nenhuma linha da Orbe aponta para venda
    anterior ao mês e o EC não tem taxa vigente na planilha no primeiro dia do mês.
    """
    por_ec: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    antigo: set[str] = set()
    for r in registros:
        ec = str(r["cod_estabelecimento"]).strip()
        por_ec[ec].append(r)
        dvo = _data(r["data_venda_original"])
        if dvo and dvo < inicio_mes:
            antigo.add(ec)

    saida = []
    for ec in sorted(por_ec):
        if ec in antigo:
            continue
        loj = cadastro.lojista_por_ec(ec)
        if loj and cadastro.taxa_contratada_pct(loj.cnpj, "DEBITO", 1, inicio_mes) is not None:
            continue
        linhas = sorted(
            (r for r in por_ec[ec] if r["tipo_lancamento"] in TIPOS and r["tipo_lancamento"] != "ESTORNO"),
            key=lambda r: _data(r["data_movimento"]) or inicio_mes,
        )
        ant = ven = Decimal(0)
        pico: tuple[Decimal, date | None, Decimal, Decimal] = (Decimal(0), None, Decimal(0), Decimal(0))
        dias = sorted({_data(r["data_movimento"]) for r in linhas} - {None})
        for dia in dias:
            for r in linhas:
                if _data(r["data_movimento"]) != dia:
                    continue
                if r["tipo_lancamento"] == "VENDA":
                    ven += r["valor_bruto"]
                else:
                    ant += r["valor_bruto"]
            if ant - ven > pico[0]:
                pico = (ant - ven, dia, ant, ven)
        excesso, dia_pico, ant_pico, ven_pico = pico
        if dia_pico is None:
            continue
        comps = [
            Componente(
                r["arquivo_origem"],
                str(r["id_transacao"]),
                r["valor_bruto"] if r["tipo_lancamento"] != "VENDA" else -r["valor_bruto"],
            )
            for r in linhas
            if (_data(r["data_movimento"]) or inicio_mes) <= dia_pico
        ]
        reversoes = [r for r in linhas if r["tipo_lancamento"] == "REVERSAO ANTECIPACAO"]
        rev_txt = (
            f" Houve {len(reversoes)} reversões de antecipação no mês, somando "
            f"{_brl_txt(-sum((r['valor_bruto'] for r in reversoes), Decimal(0)))}."
            if reversoes
            else ""
        )
        nome = loj.nome if loj else str(linhas[0]["nome_estabelecimento"]).strip() if linhas else ec
        saida.append(
            _pendencia(
                f"ANTECIPACAO-{ec}",
                "ALERTA_ANTECIPACAO",
                comps,
                f"{nome} (EC {ec}), lojista sem venda antes do mês: em {dia_pico:%d/%m} a antecipação acumulada "
                f"({_brl_txt(ant_pico)}) superou as vendas acumuladas ({_brl_txt(ven_pico)}) em {_brl_txt(excesso)}."
                f"{rev_txt} Valor = antecipações menos vendas até o pico.",
                f"{HELENA} e Comercial",
                "P-08 R-36",
            )
        )
    return saida

- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use a 1-hour Anthropic prompt-cache TTL, so effectively every allowed delay (the runtime clamps to [60, 3600]) wakes up with your conversation context still cached. There is no cache cliff inside that range to pace around, and scheduling extra wakeups just to keep the cache warm is pure waste — never do that. (If the session enters usage overage, later requests drop to the 5-minute TTL; don't try to track or preempt that — the guidance here stays the same.)

Match the delay to what you're actually waiting for:

- **Actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about** (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue): pick the delay from how fast that state actually changes. A CI run that takes ~8 minutes deserves one ~480s check, not eight 60s ones.
- **The long fallback heartbeat** (something else — a Monitor, a task notification — is the primary wake signal): 1200s+, so quiet wakeups stay rare.
- **Idle ticks with no specific signal to watch**: default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop still checks back regularly, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Don't think in cache windows — think about what you're actually waiting for.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

A workflow size guideline is configured for this session: small — keep workflows under 5 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale.

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

entries.name: SendMessage
entries.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

def _primeiras_linhas(p: Path, n: int = 6) -> str:
    try:
        with p.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace") as f:
            return "".join(f.readline() for _ in range(n))

def descobrir(input_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Path]:
    """D-01, P-15: o nome de setembro é só o primeiro palpite; se não existir, o papel sai do conteúdo."""
    fixos = {"taxas": ARQ_TAXAS, "ponte": ARQ_PONTE, "plano_contas": ARQ_FENIX, "aurora": ARQ_AURORA, "meridiano": ARQ_MERIDIANO}
    achados = {papel: input_dir / nome for papel, nome in fixos.items() if (input_dir / nome).is_file()}
    arquivos = sorted(p for p in input_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file())
    criterios = {
        "taxas": lambda p: p.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx",
        "ponte": lambda p: p.suffix.lower() == ".eml",
        "meridiano": lambda p: p.suffix.lower() == ".ofx",
        "plano_contas": lambda p: p.suffix.lower() == ".csv" and "COD_CONTA" in _primeiras_linhas(p, 1),
        "aurora": lambda p: p.suffix.lower() == ".csv" and "aurora" in _primeiras_linhas(p).lower(),
    }
    for papel, ok in criterios.items():

            cand = [p for p in arquivos if p not in achados.values() and ok(p)]
            if cand:

    faltando = sorted(set(fixos) - set(achados))
